finding.claim: Verification cache TTL ignores exp when iat is absent and ignores maxAge when exp is present, so cached successes are served past token expiry or maxAge for up to cacheTTL (default 600000 ms).
finding.source: Token holder presents a previously valid token (E1, src/verifier.js:353). Precondition: cache enabled with cache: true (src/verifier.js:83-86).
finding.sink: Cache-hit short-circuit returning the cached payload without re-running claim validators (src/verifier.js:363-379, return at 377).

trace.note: Sync success stored via cacheSet(cacheContext, payload); async success at line 471.
hasIat is false for tokens without iat, so cacheValue[1]=0 and the exp branch (lines 120-129) is skipped.
maxAge branch only runs when exp is absent; when exp is present cacheValue[2]=exp*1000 and maxAge is ignored.
cacheValue[2] falls back to maxTTL = now + cacheTTL when no bound was set.
Cache lookup happens before decode and before verifyToken.
min===0 satisfies the first condition; line 374 passes while now <= max.
handleCachedResult returns the cached payload; validators at 304-323 never run.

finding.guards_checked: Cache key is a full-token hash (src/utils.js:45-58), so no collision and no signature substitution. Only successes are cached on this path. Cache is opt-in (src/verifier.js:83-86). No time-claim re-check exists on a cache hit. Impact: expired iat-less tokens and maxAge-exceeding tokens are accepted for up to cacheTTL after first verification.

finding.claim: Non-TokenError exceptions raised during claim validation are cached as successful results and later returned as verified claims.
finding.source: Issuer-signed token with an nbf or exp outside the JS Date range (E6, claims). Narrow precondition: a signing verifier cannot be driven by an attacker to produce this.
finding.sink: Cache-hit path returns any non-TokenError cached value as success (src/verifier.js:141-154).

trace.note: new Date(adjusted).toISOString() throws RangeError for out-of-range values (called from validateClaimDateValue at 198-205).
Sync path: throw cacheSet(cacheContext, e) stores the RangeError.
cacheSet handles only TokenError as an error; the RangeError is stored as a success with maxTTL from line 134.
handleCachedResult: non-TokenError cached value falls through to return cached as success (line 153 for callback path).

finding.guards_checked: Signature verified before claims, so the claims are issuer-signed. Cache lookup runs before exception handling. The RangeError only hits the cache when iat is absent (lines 368-374 reject it otherwise). Impact: later calls return an Error object as verified claims instead of the payload; apps testing only truthiness could treat this as authenticated with no identity. Robustness bug with narrow trigger.
